name: ButlerFun
short: AI extras: catch-up summaries, rulings, text adventures, trivia writing and guess the game.
description: Built on the Claude cog: /catchup summarizes a channel since you last spoke (only you see it), judge settles an argument in ButlerBot's voice, adventure runs a group text adventure in a thread, maketrivia writes a list for Red's trivia game, and guessgame has Gemini paint a game from the server's library for everyone to guess.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores each member's guess-the-game win count and which threads are running adventures. Messages read for catch-ups, rulings and adventures are sent to Anthropic's API and not stored by this cog.
install_msg: Thanks for installing ButlerFun! It needs the Claude cog; guessgame also needs Gemini and GameManager. Enable the /catchup slash command with `[p]slash enable catchup` and `[p]slash sync`.
author: Quillshot
